posts.author: Shinymitz
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
The most fundamental problem - you have an Autorun event that doesn't turn off.
Autorun and parallel events will try to execute once every frame - 60 times a second. You should never have an Autorun event that doesn't turn off either with a self switch to go to another page, or Erase Event, depending on how you want it to work...but you should know the difference between those things.
You might want to look up some event tutorials to shore up how the different types of event work.
Click to expand...

That's the point of troubleshooting.
If you knew what the problem was, you wouldn't have the problem and you wouldn't need to ask for help - so it doesn't make sense to presume you know which plugins might be interacting with it.
(and from a technical point of view, it makes perfect sense that "water reflection," which is drawing sprites, could interact with someone else that's drawing sprites)
If you'd turned them all off, you would've figured it out at that moment and not wasted any time looking at the other events on your map and making a new test project
It's just good logic to help you next time you have a problem. Good luck with your project!
